title: Studio in STEPS
description: Studio apartment in Steps Batumi residential complex. Without Steps management. Address: Batumi, 2b Grigol Lortkipanidze St. 23rd floor, 31.6 m². New Boulevard: near Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park, Metro City mall. New business-class complex — reception and 24/7 security. Infrastructure: botanical garden, business centre, restaurant, hotel, parking, playground, pool, sauna, hammam, café, gym. About 150 m to the sea, 4 high-speed lifts with backup power, fire-safe rooms with oxygen supply. Suitable for living and rental. Spacious bright studio with quality renovation, furniture and appliances, mountain and city view, sunny side. Price $61,000 — confirm current price and deal terms with your manager.
